model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the ‘effect’ across several language families, with error bars indicating variability. The horizontal axis displays language family categories—IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic—presented in that specific order and without additional sorting. The vertical axis is labeled ‘effect’ and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 5.  For each language family, there are five bars grouped together. The bars represent models XLM-L2 (light blue), mBERT-R2 (coral), XLM-R2 (green), mBERT-B2 (teal), and XLM-B2 (red). The height of the bars varies depending on the language family and model, with the shortest bars typically around a value of 2 for models XLM-L2 and mBERT-B2 specifically for the ‘Semitic’ language family and the tallest bars reaching up to approximately 24 for mBERT-R2 for the ‘IE-Romance’ language family. Each bar also includes an error bar extending vertically, indicating the range of values around the mean. No bars are specifically emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
